Required Fields on a New Salary Rule

User manual · English · 7 steps
Learn what happens when you save a salary rule without its name, code and category, which payroll formulas rely on.

1. Open Payroll

Open the Payroll app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Rules

Click Rules.

4. New

Click New to start a salary rule.

5. Save

Click the save icon without filling anything in.

6. Read the message

Read the red message. Click it to continue.

7. Discard

Click the discard icon to leave without saving.
